prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: a single transparent 2D mushroom gold coin collectible sprite for the same hand-drawn Godot forward runner.
Input image 1: warm muted gold palette and ochre colored outline reference only; do not copy badge, banners, stars, character or typography.
Input image 2: previous forest scenery's clean flat hand-drawn shapes and economical matte fill reference only; do not copy foliage.
Input image 3: simplified mushroom cap silhouette reference only; do not copy monster identity, face, eyes, limbs, or colors.
Primary request: ONE round gold coin bearing one large simple raised mushroom emblem, easy to recognize as a pickup along a dark checkerboard forest road. The emblem has a broad gently domed cap, exactly three large simple cap spots, a short substantial stem and a slightly flared base, all in golden tones. No face. A single inset rim around the disk and a thin visible coin edge on the lower-right give just enough thickness. Mostly front-facing with a very slight three-quarter turn, keeping the mushroom clearly readable. The mushroom emblem occupies around 65% of the inner disk, with wide clear separation between shapes, suitable at 64-128 pixels.
Style: FLAT hand-drawn illustration matching the previous assets, restrained solid matte color blocks, confident gently organic contours, at most two simple flat shadow planes. No metallic photorealism, glossy gradient, bevel render, oily shine, excessive texture, grain or stippling. No black outlines; use warm ochre/brass contours.
Palette: soft antique gold #D8B467, pale muted gold #E9CD88, warm ochre #A48146 and restrained bronze #987445. Warm enough to contrast the dark teal forest while remaining desaturated. No neon yellow, orange oversaturation or pure white sparkle.
Composition: one isolated coherent coin centered on a square high-resolution canvas, complete natural silhouette, 15% genuine transparent margin on every side. Upright coin, no ground plane, cast floor shadow, platform, grass, road, mushroom growing out of the coin or scenery.
Avoid: additional coins, scattered coins, sparkles, particles, glow, haze, decorative stars, letters, numbers, text, watermark, limbs, faces, black strokes, noise, dirty/muddy textures, oversaturated colors, shiny oil paint. Genuine transparent background RGBA PNG.
